title: GTA 6 generates record impact on internet traffic and depletes vacation days for thousands of gamers
summary: The launch of the highly anticipated video game accounts for a quarter of global network traffic and triggers a massive request for days off.

title: Players resort to negative reviews to express their discontent with GTA 6 on digital platforms
summary: The title suffers from 'review bombing' campaigns related to content management and in-game moderation.
